value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks cooler than today. Expect partly sunny skies and a high around 65°F, about 15 degrees below Monday. Rain or showers could move in Tuesday evening, with about a 30% chance after 3 p.m. that climbs into the night. Lows drop into the 30s and low 40s overnight. Wind is north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, with gusts up to 17 mph in the afternoon.
